question_patterns: Tell me about a time when you had to make a decision with incomplete information (Bias for Action).
Give an example of when you went above and beyond your standard responsibilities (Ownership).
Tell me about a time you made a significant mistake and how you rectified it (Earn Trust / Dive Deep).
evaluation_focus: Deep behavioral alignment with Leadership Principles using the STAR method, structured metrics, scalability tradeoffs, and high ownership.

question_patterns: How would you design a distributed cache with LRU eviction across 1000 nodes?
Analyze the asymptotic time and space complexity of your algorithm and optimize it to O(n log k).
Describe how you navigated a technically ambiguous project where requirements were undefined.
evaluation_focus: First-principles algorithmic reasoning, asymptotic complexity mastery, clean modular code design, scalability, and intellectual curiosity.

question_patterns: How quickly can you prototype a fullstack feature and ship it to production?
What tradeoffs do you make between code perfection and speed to market?
Tell me about a time you wore multiple hats (dev, ops, design) to get a feature live.
evaluation_focus: Pragmatic problem solving, practical fullstack execution, bias towards rapid delivery, and ability to handle chaos with autonomy.
